content.text: {"summary":"Hidden unit 3 never activates on the domain, so it was repurposed. Its weights become W1[3]=[0,1,0] and b1[3]=1, giving z3=v+1, which stays at or above 0 for v in [-1,1], so the ReLU acts linearly. Setting W2[3]=-0.2 adds -0.2*v-0.2, and raising b2 by 0.2 cancels the constant, so f_new=f_old-0.2*v on the domain with everything else unchanged. The original damping c was estimated at about 0.72, read off as the slope of the network with respect to v at the origin.","estimated_c":0.72,"patches":[{"tensor":"W1","index":[3,0],"value":0.0},{"tensor":"W1","index":[3,1],"value":1.0},{"tensor":"W1","index":[3,2],"value":0.0},{"tensor":"b1","index":[3],"value":1.0},{"tensor":"W2","index":[3],"value":-0.2},{"tensor":"b2","index":[0],"value":0.00393424}]}
